description: This file defines the SearchIndexInterface interface for managing search index functions in Drupal, including methods for indexing, clearing, reindexing, and updating word weights.

classes.name: SearchIndexInterface
classes.description: Interface for search index management functions in Drupal.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Updates the full-text search index for a specific item, returning words to be updated.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears part or all of the search index.

methods.name: markForReindex
methods.description: Marks indexed items for reindexing by updating their timestamps.

methods.name: updateWordWeights
methods.description: Updates the total weights of words in the search index.
